We at Noriega’s are home cabinetry experts. Our goal is to give you help and ideas for your home cabinets. We will give you the finish or style that is right for your home and preference.
We offer free consultations and full functionality planning and design.

Noriega’s works with only the finest quality tools and materials. From template to installation, we are devoted to quality craftsmanship and professionalism. Our promise of quality is backed by our 100% warranty on materials and workmanship. We have been making custom cabinets and countertops for years and we can make your home look brand new. At Noriega’s, we treat your project as if it were a work of art and offer custom fabrication and installation with trained professionals.

Noriega’s staff represents years of residential experience in every area from new home construction, home repairs, remodeling, and custom cabinetry.

We would love to help with your kitchen cabinet plans or new countertop ideas, located in Mt. Pleasant, Pittsburg, and Texarkana, TX, feel free to stop by and see us during our normal business hours.
